generated.details: The samples are thin, separate rectangular pieces of pale stone, oak veneer and gray laminate, with exposed edges and flat undersides resting on the table.
At near right, the clear glass paperweight is a solid palm-sized rounded dome with a flat base resting directly on the tabletop.
Beyond the table in the far left and center, the frosted architectural partition has translucent glass panes secured within slim aluminum uprights and a floor-mounted bottom channel.
